players.note: Tucker didn't play any offensive snaps in Sunday's 16-0 win over the Falcons.

players.name: Luke Schoonmaker
players.note: questionable

players.name: Isaiah Bond
players.note: Bond went without a target while taking the field for eight of the Browns' 70 snaps on offense in Sunday's 27-6 loss to the Steelers. He returned one kickoff for 26 yards.

players.name: Drew Ogletree
players.note: Ogletree (knee) is active Week 8 against the Jaguars.

players.name: Chris Blair
players.note: Blair went without a target while playing nine of the Falcons' 53 offensive snaps in Sunday's 16-0 loss to the Buccaneers.

players.name: Kene Nwangwu
players.note: Nwangwu was a full participant in Wednesday's practice.

players.name: Myles Price
players.note: Price (head) was back on the field for the second quarter of Sunday's game against the Colts, Ben Goessling of The Minnesota Star Tribune reports.

players.name: Jacob Cowing
players.note: Cowing caught three of five passes for 38 yards, added a 10-yard carry and returned one kickoff for 28 yards during Sunday's 29-20 loss to the Falcons.

players.name: LaJohntay Wester
players.note: Wester went without a target while playing six of the Ravens' 51 snaps on offense in Sunday's 36-10 loss to the Bills. He also returned three kickoffs for 71 yards and one punt for two yards.

players.name: Greg Dortch
players.note: Dortch went without a target while logging four of the Bills' 82 snaps on offense in Sunday's 36-10 win over the Ravens. He returned one kickoff for 22 yards and three punts for 40 yards.

players.name: Britain Covey
players.note: questionable

players.name: Jacob Saylors
players.note: Saylors (neck) is not expected to practice Wednesday, Nolan Bianchi of The Detroit News reports.

players.name: Jordan James
players.note: James logged a six-yard carry, turned his lone target into an 11-yard catch and registered 119 yards on four kickoff returns during the 49ers' 29-20 loss to the Falcons on Sunday.

players.name: Malachi Corley
players.note: Corley went untargeted while playing 13 of 70 snaps on offense Sunday in the Browns' 27-6 loss to the Steelers. He returned one kickoff for 26 yards.

players.name: De'Zhaun Stribling
players.note: Stribling (ankle) was spotted Monday walking without crutches or a brace on his lower leg, Matt Barrows of The Athletic reports.

players.name: Isiah Pacheco
players.note: Lions coach Dan Campbell said Friday that Pacheco (back) has a chance to return in late December, Justin Rogers of DetroitFootball.net reports.

players.name: Jaylin Noel
players.note: Noel, who was placed on injured reserve earlier Wednesday, is expected to require surgery to address his toe injury and will miss the remainder of the season, Jonathan M. Alexander of the Houston Chronicle reports.

players.name: Xavier Legette
players.note: Panthers head coach Dave Canales said Monday that Legette (knee) will "potentially" be designated for return from injured reserve this week, Joe Person of The Athletic reports.

players.name: Isaiah Davis
players.note: Davis rushed five times for 15 yards in Sunday's 38-33 loss to the Raiders.

players.name: Andrei Iosivas
players.note: Iosivas (thumb) is making good progress in his rehab, Mike Petraglia of CLNSCincy.com reports.

players.name: Kendre Miller
players.note: Miller rushed eight times for six yards in Sunday's 16-10 loss to the Steelers in Paris.

players.name: DJ Giddens
players.note: Giddens racked up 43 yards on six carries in Indianapolis' Week 8 loss to Jacksonville on Sunday.

players.name: Mack Hollins
players.note: Hollins (calf), who is eligible to be activated from IR this week, per Doug Kyed of the Boston Herald, could return to practice Wednesday, Evan Lazar of the Patriots' official site reports.

players.name: Erick All Jr.
players.note: Bengals head coach Zac Taylor confirmed Wednesday that All has been diagnosed with a torn ACL in his right knee and will require season-ending surgery, Jay Morrison of SI.com reports.

players.name: Carson Beck
players.note: Head coach Mike LaFleur said that Beck will serve as the Cardinals' No. 2 quarterback behind starter Gardner Minshew in Sunday's game against the Seahawks, Darren Urban of the team's official site reports.

players.name: Anthony Richardson Sr.
players.note: Richardson entered the Colts' 42-7 loss to the Jaguars on Sunday for an ineffective Daniel Jones with 11:45 remaining and completed both his pass attempts for eight yards while rushing twice for four yards.

players.name: Jalon Daniels
players.note: Daniels was back in his primary reserve role behind Baker Mayfield in Sunday's 43-13 win over the Panthers.

players.name: Kendrick Bourne
players.note: Arizona placed Bourne (tibia) on injured reserve Tuesday, Darren Urban of the Cardinals' official site reports.

players.name: Jaylin Lane
players.note: Lane underwent surgery Oct. 9 to repair his fractured and dislocated ankle, and he is expected to be cleared for activities before OTAs, Tashan Reed of The Washington Post reports.

players.name: Brenen Thompson
players.note: Thompson (quadriceps/hamstring) is not expected to practice this week, Noah Furtado of The Athletic reports.

players.name: Demarcus Robinson
players.note: 49ers coach Kyle Shanahan reiterated Monday that Robinson (ankle) has a chance to return following the team's Week 8 bye, David Lombardi of SFStandard.com reports.

players.name: KeAndre Lambert-Smith
players.note: Lambert-Smith is likely to drop down the wideout pecking order Sunday versus the Rams, as Eric Smith of the Chargers' official site reports that both Ladd McConkey (concussion) and Tre' Harris (hamstring) are set to return to action.

players.name: Spencer Rattler
players.note: Rattler is active and will remain the Saints' No. 2 quarterback for Sunday's game against the Steelers in Paris, Ross Jackson of WWL Louisiana reports.

players.name: Mason Rudolph
players.note: Rudolph is active for Sunday's game against the Saints in Paris, Teresa Varley of the Steelers' official site reports.

players.name: Jeremy McNichols
players.note: The Commanders placed McNichols (foot) on injured reserve Tuesday.

players.name: Case Keenum
players.note: Keenum (coach's decision) is inactive but will operate as the Bears' emergency third quarterback for Monday night's matchup against the Seahawks.

players.name: Brandon Aiyuk
players.note: Aiyuk is close to hiring new representation and is expected to file for reinstatement to the NFL in the near future, according to NFL reporter Jordan Schultz.

players.name: Brevin Jordan
players.note: Jordan (foot) does not have any injury designation ahead of Sunday's game against the Giants, Adam Caplan of SiriusXM NFL Radio reports.

players.name: Sam Ehlinger
players.note: Ehlinger (coach's decision) is inactive but will be the third emergency quarterback against the Chiefs on Sunday, Aric DiLalla of the Broncos' official site reports.

players.name: David Sills V
players.note: Sills (hamstring) was activated from injured reserve by the Buccaneers on Thursday, Scott Smith of the team's official website reports.

players.name: Roschon Johnson
players.note: Johnson carried five times for 17 yards and added an 11-yard reception on his lone target in Monday's 34-17 win over the Seahawks.

players.name: Jared Wayne
players.note: Wayne (coach's decision) is inactive for Sunday's game versus the Patriots.

players.name: Tyrell Shavers
players.note: The Bills designated Shavers (knee) to return from the reserve/PUP list Wednesday, but he will not play against the Ravens on Sunday, Cameron Wolfe of NFL Network reports.

players.name: Beaux Collins
players.note: Collins (hip) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Buccaneers and will remain on injured reserve, Tori McElhaney of the Falcons' official site reports.

players.name: Carter Runyon
players.note: Runyon (foot) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Jets, Sam Warren of The Athletic reports.

players.name: Behren Morton
players.note: Morton (coach's decision) is inactive but will serve as the Patriots' emergency third quarterback against the Dolphins on Sunday.

players.name: Athan Kaliakmanis
players.note: Kaliakmanis (coach's decision) is inactive but serving as the Commanders' emergency third quarterback Sunday night against the Eagles.

players.name: Garrett Nussmeier
players.note: Nussmeier (coach's decision) is inactive for Sunday's game against Denver, though he will be available as the team's emergency quarterback.

players.name: Montorie Foster Jr.
players.note: The Seahawks elevated Foster from their practice squad Monday ahead of the team's matchup versus the Bears, John Boyle of the team's official site reports.

players.name: Dare Ogunbowale
players.note: Ogunbowale didn't record an offensive touch or target in Sunday's 24-21 overtime loss to the Giants.

players.name: David Moore
players.note: Moore didn't receive any playing time on offense and logged two snaps on special teams in Thursday's 27-19 loss to the Packers.

players.name: Stephen Carlson
players.note: The Bears elevated Carlson from their practice squad Monday ahead of the team's matchup versus Seattle.

players.name: Michael Carter
players.note: Carter (abdomen) is questionable to return to Sunday night's contest against the Commanders.

players.name: Khalil Herbert
players.note: Herbert reverted to the Falcons' practice squad Monday, per the NFL's transaction log.

players.name: Velus Jones Jr.
players.note: questionable

players.name: Dameon Pierce
players.note: The Eagles placed Pierce (undisclosed) on injured reserve Wednesday

players.name: DJ Turner
players.note: Turner (ankle) is considered day-to-day, NFL reporter Jordan Schultz reported Monday.

players.name: Jake Moody
players.note: Head coach Jesse Minter said Monday that Moody is on track to be elevated from the practice squad to handle kicking duties for the Ravens in Thursday's game against the Jaguars,  Sam Cohn of The Baltimore Sun reports.
